U4.ratings: VDD 2.4-3.6 V, VDDIO 1.7-3.6 V (Table 0-1, p13); both on +3V3. I2C bus load max 400 pF (Table 4-6, p99).
U4.config: PS1=PS0=0 -> standard/fast I2C (Table 4-4, p99; floating not allowed: both tied to GND). COM3 low -> 0x28 (Table 4-7, p100), matches firmware BNO055_ADDRESS 0x28. COM2 = GNDIO in I2C mode (Table 4-5 p99, Table 5-1): tied to GND, correct. nBOOT_LOAD_PIN 10k pull-up to VDDIO (R12) matches Figure 9 (p107) 'Pull-up 10k'; boot into application requires it high at reset (sec 3.x bootloader text). nRESET 10k pull-up (R11) matches Figure 9 'Optional 10k'; nRESET is not routed to the ESP32, so only POR resets the IMU (acceptable, firmware uses software reset). VDD 100 nF (C17) matches Figure 9 100nF; VDDIO 100 nF (C18) vs Figure 9 120 nF (Xplained Pro uses 120n + 6.8n). INT and BL_IND unconnected: both outputs, Figure 9 marks them as optional outputs; firmware polls, so OK. SWDIO/SWCLK left open as 'optional debugger connection', OK. Crystal: Figure 12 / Table 5-2 (p110) recommend 22 pF on each of XIN32/XOUT32, footnote 9 'typical example only'. Design uses 22 pF C19/C20 to GND with a 12.5 pF crystal: effective CL = 22/2 + ~2-3 pF stray = 13-14 pF, about 1 pF above the crystal's 12.5 pF, pulling it roughly -5 to -10 ppm, inside the +-20 ppm tolerance and irrelevant for fusion timing. Strictly ideal would be 2*(12.5-2.5) = 20 pF, not worth a change. firmware setExtCrystalUse(true) needs the crystal; BNO055 falls back to internal clock if the signal is bad (p110).
issues: VDDIO cap 100 nF vs 120 nF in Figure 9: within tolerance, fine. Place C17/C18 close to pins 3 and 28 (footnote 10, p110).
nRESET only has a pull-up; the MCU cannot hardware-reset a hung BNO055 (clock-stretch lockups are a known BNO055 behaviour). Optional: route nRESET to a spare ESP32 GPIO.
U4.fixed: CAP cap raised from 100 nF to 1 uF (Bosch figures 9-11).

U2.part: TI TPS54202DDC, 4.5-28 V 2 A synchronous buck, SOT-23-6 (DDC), LCSC C191884
U2.pinout: Table 4-1 / pin diagram p3: 1 GND, 2 SW, 3 VIN, 4 FB, 5 EN, 6 BOOT. pad_to_net: 1 GND, 2 SW, 3 VBATT, 4 FB, 5 unconnected (EN), 6 BUCK_BOOT. Matches. Pad geometry is the standard SOT-23-6 CCW order (1 top-left, 3 bottom-left, 4 bottom-right, 6 top-right), 0.95 mm pitch.
U2.footprint: Package_TO_SOT_SMD:SOT-23-6 fits the DDC (SOT-23-thin, 2.9 x 1.6 mm body, 0.95 mm pitch). Pass.
U2.ratings: VIN recommended 4.5-28 V, abs max 30 V (5.1 p4, 5.3 p4). 4S max 17.4 V LiHV leaves 12.6 V of headroom for steady state. HS current limit 2.5/3.2/3.9 A min/typ/max, Fsw 390/500/630 kHz, VFB 0.581/0.596/0.611 V (5.5 p5). Pulse-skip below ~300 mA peak inductor current (6.3.2 p9). EN abs max 7 V.
U2.config: Vout = 0.596 x (1 + 100k/12k) = 5.56 V nominal (eq 7 p14). Worst case with VFB limits and 1% resistors: 5.33-5.81 V. EN floating: Table 4-1 p3 says 'Float EN pin to enable'; 6.3.x p9 says the small pull-up current Ip sets the default state to enabled with no external components (I(EN_INPUT) 0.7 uA at VEN=1 V, p5). Floating EN is a supported configuration. Boot cap 100 nF X7R 16 V 0402 (C1525) between BOOT and SW: datasheet requires a 0.1 uF ceramic (7.2.3.2 p14); BOOT-SW sees ~5 V, so 16 V is fine. Input: 2x 10 uF 25 V X5R 0805 (C15850) + 100 nF 50 V X7R 0402 (C307331). Datasheet asks for >10 uF ceramic, X5R/X7R, rated above max VIN, 0.1 uF HF optional (7.2.3.1 p14). 25 V > 17.4 V passes. DC bias at 17 V on a 25 V 0805 10 uF X5R typically leaves ~25-35% (my estimate, not from the C15850 datasheet), so ~6 uF effective for the pair, under the 10 uF guideline. Ripple at 0.6 A with 6 uF: eq 4 gives ~50 mV, well under the 400 mV design target, so acceptable at this load. Output: 2x 22 uF 25 V X5R 0805 (C45783) at 5.56 V: estimated ~9-12 uF each after DC bias, ~20 uF effective vs Table 7-2 p17's 44 uF for 5 V (the TI design uses 2x 22 uF 25 V X7R and notes derating must be added, 7.2.3.5.2 p16). Output ripple at 17.4 V: dI = 0.76 A pp, eq 12 gives ~10 mV pp with 20 uF. Transient eq 11 for a 0.35 A step and 5% (0.28 V) dip needs 5 uF: passes. No feed-forward cap C6 across R_top: Table 7-2 p17 lists C6 = 75 pF for 5 V and 7.2.3.5.3 p16 says low-ESR ceramic Cout can give low phase margin, fixed by C6 = 1/(2 pi fo R2) (eq 16 p17). Estimated crossover from eq 14 (fo = 3.95/(Vout x Cout)) is ~35 kHz with 20 uF effective vs ~18 kHz for the datasheet's 44 uF, i.e. the board runs at about twice the datasheet's crossover with no phase boost. Not provably unstable, but outside every row of Table 7-2. FB is taken at V5_BUCK, ahead of D1, so the Schottky is outside the loop. Good.
issues: Buck layout (input loop, SW node, FB routing, 7.4.1 p20) is checked by eye on the render, not by a script.
U2.fixed: Feed-forward 47 pF C0G added across R_top (7.2.3.5.3; table 7-2 lists 75 pF). L1 raised to 15 uH per table 7-2. 100 uF 35 V electrolytic (C88744) added on VBATT at the board, user's choice, to damp hot-plug ringing (section 7.3); also supplies the bulk input capacitance the derated ceramics lack. Third 22 uF output cap added: two derated to about 20 uF, which with the feed-forward cap put crossover near 100 kHz; three bring it to about 33 kHz (sim/buck_loop.py), under the 40 kHz guidance (7.2.3.5.2).

L1.datasheet: Cjiang 'Wire Wound SMD Power Inductors - FNR Series', https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/a0b12ba9dfe6b9e66b6bb852b7c71c03.pdf (19 pp). FNR4030S table p10, dimensions and land pattern p2.

Cjiang recommended land (p2, FNR4030S row): gap a = 1.9, pad width b = 1.1, pad length C = 3.7, i.e. pads at +-0.95..+-2.05 mm. For this 0.6 A load it is a ripple choice, not a defect: dI = Vout(Vin-Vout)/(Vin L fsw) = 0.76 A pp nominal at 17.4 V, 1.21 A pp worst case (L -20%, fsw 390 kHz). Peak inductor current at 0.6 A load: eq 10 gives 1.07 A; worst case 0.6 + 0.61 = 1.21 A. That is 62% of Isat 1.95 A and 0.6 A RMS vs Irms 1.5 A. Copper loss ~0.05 W. Ripple ratio vs load ~1.3, so the converter runs in DCM / pulse-skip (6.3.2 p9) at light load: expected and harmless. Duty cycle max 5.56/12.8 = 43%, under 50%, so no subharmonic concern. U3.ratings: Abs max VCC 6.5 V (p3). Recommended VIN 2.5-6.0 V (p3). AP2112-3.3 table p8: Vout 3.3 V +-1.5%, Iout(max) 600 mA, dropout 125/200 mV typ/max at 300 mA and 250/400 mV at 600 mA, IQ 55 uA. EN VIH 1.5 V min to 6.0 V max, EN has a 3 MOhm pull-down (p4 table, repeated per variant). SOT25 thetaJA 184 C/W (p3).
U3.config: +5V range: buck path 5.33-5.81 V minus B5819W VF (~0.38 V at 0.5 A, ~0.25 V at 50 mA from the p2 curve) gives ~4.95-5.56 V; USB path 4.75-5.5 V minus VF gives ~4.4-5.25 V. Max ~5.56 V is under the 6.0 V operating max and the 6.5 V abs max. Even the TPS54202 OVP point (108% Vref, ~6.0 V at V5_BUCK, 6.3.x p12) minus a diode stays under 6.0 V. Minimum ~4.4 V on USB leaves >0.7 V over the 400 mV max dropout at 600 mA. EN tied to VIN: legal, VIH max equals the 6.0 V VIN limit. Caps: datasheet characterises with 1 uF ceramic in and out, X5R/X7R (Note 4 p1, test conditions p8). Design: 1 uF 25 V X5R 0402 in (C52923) plus 10 uF 10 V X5R 0603 on +5V (C9), 10 uF 10 V X5R 0603 out (C19702) plus the ESP32 10 uF and several 100 nF. Meets the 1 uF minimum after derating; the datasheet gives no maximum Cout. Thermal: (5.2 - 3.3) V x 150 mA average = 0.29 W, ~+52 C rise at 184 C/W; a sustained 350 mA would be 0.67 W / +120 C, but ESP32-S3 Wi-Fi TX peaks are ms-scale bursts.
issues: Dissipation is the only soft spot: the 5.56 V buck setpoint (chosen to absorb the Schottky drop) puts ~1.9-2.2 V across the LDO. Fine for average ESP32-S3 load, but give the SOT25 GND/VIN pads copper and vias to In1 GND. Layout: 1 uF input cap at pin 1/pin 2, 10 uF output cap at pin 5/pin 2, short GND returns.

D2.part: B5819W 40 V 1 A Schottky, SOD-123, LCSC C8598 (JSCJ)
D2.datasheet: JSCJ B5817W-B5819W rev D Mar 2015, same URL as D1 (p1 ratings, p2 curves)
D2.pinout: pad_to_net: 1 (K) +5V, 2 (A) VBUS_USB. Correct: USB -> +5V, blocks +5V from back-driving VBUS. Check cathode bar silkscreen on pad 1.
D2.ratings: Same as D1: VR 40 V, IO 1 A, VF max 0.6 V at 1 A, Pd 500 mW (p1).
D2.config: USB-only: VBUS 4.75-5.5 V minus ~0.3-0.4 V gives ~4.4-5.2 V on +5V, enough for the AP2112K (needs 3.3 V + 0.4 V max dropout). With battery present the buck output (5.18 V at 0.5 A) sits above VBUS - VF (~4.6-5.1 V), so the buck carries the load and D2 is reverse-biased by ~0-0.7 V, or shares current near the overlap; either is harmless. Reverse stress ~5.2 V max when VBUS is unplugged.
issues: If the USB port is a full 500 mA source and the ESP32 bursts with the Crossfire RX on USB-only, total ~0.5 A through D2 is fine for the diode; the USB host's current limit is outside this review.

USB1.part: Korean Hroparts Elec TYPE-C-31-M-06, 24-pin vertical SMD USB-C receptacle, H=9.3 mm (LCSC C129019)
USB1.datasheet: https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/acd7eb412bbdc46d84f757424f53047d.pdf (HRO drawing TYPE-C-31-M-xx rev A, 2021-04-20, 1 sheet; AutoCAD text not extractable, read from a 600 dpi render)
USB1.pinout: Sheet 1 pin table: A1/A12/B1/B12 GND, A4/A9/B4/B9 VBUS, A5 CC1, B5 CC2, A6 Dp1, A7 Dn1, B6 Dp2, B7 Dn2, A8 SBU1, B8 SBU2, A2/A3/A10/A11/B2/B3/B10/B11 SuperSpeed. EasyEDA symbol pin numbers/names match this table one for one (EH = pad 25 shell). Netlist: A6+B6 USB_DP, A7+B7 USB_DM, A5 USB_CC1, B5 USB_CC2 (each 5.1k to GND per design.py), VBUS pins VBUS_USB, GND pins + 25 GND, SS/SBU unconnected. Correct for a USB 2.0 sink.
USB1.footprint: Recommended PCB layout (top view), sheet 1: A1 top-left, A12 top-right, B12 bottom-left (under A1), B1 bottom-right (under A12). Footprint (y down): A1 (-2.75,-0.75), A12 (+2.75,-0.75), B12 (-2.75,+0.75), B1 (+2.75,+0.75); positions match the drawing. Pitch 0.50 and A1-A12 span 5.50 match. Pad width 0.28 vs drawing 0.30. Pad rows: drawing puts each row 0.41..1.26 mm from the centerline (0.85 long); footprint is 0.275..1.225 (0.95 long), so outer edge within 0.035 mm and inner edge 0.135 mm closer to center; row-to-row gap 0.55 vs 0.82. Shell THT: 4x drill 0.70 at (+/-2.40, +/-2.15) matches 4.80 x 4.30 spacing and phi0.70; annular pad 1.20 vs drawing phi1.10. Locating pegs at x=+/-3.75 match 7.50 span; drawing shows phi0.65 hole on the A1 side and a 1.00 x 0.60 slot on the A12 side; footprint uses round NPTH 0.65 and 0.80. Bottom view shows both pegs phi0.50, so 0.80 round still clears with 0.15 mm per side (the slot only adds X tolerance).
USB1.ratings: 5 V, 5 A total VBUS/GND, 1.25 A CC, 0.25 A other contacts; -25..+85 C; reflow 260 C 10 s; PCB thickness 1.0 +/-0.10 mm per layout note (sheet 1 notes 4, 5, 6).
USB1.config: USB 2.0 only, both D+/D- rows tied, Rd 5.1k on each CC, shell to GND.
issues: Minor: signal pads 0.28 x 0.95 centered 0.75 mm off axis vs drawing 0.30 x 0.85 spanning 0.41-1.26 mm; inner pad ends sit 0.135 mm further in, leaving 0.55 mm between rows instead of 0.82. Solderable, not a defect.
Minor: A12-side locating hole is round 0.80 instead of the drawn 1.00 x 0.60 slot; 0.50 peg still fits.

Note: drawing's layout note specifies 1.0 +/-0.1 mm PCB thickness for the THT shell legs; confirm board stackup thickness (a 1.6 mm board leaves the legs flush/short, which JLC usually accepts but loses retention).

U5.part: UMW USBLC6-2SC6, 2-line ESD array + VBUS rail clamp, SOT-23-6 (LCSC C2687116)
U5.pinout: p.1 section 4: 1 I/O1, 2 GND, 3 I/O2, 4 I/O2, 5 VBUS, 6 I/O1 (pins 1/6 and 3/4 internally the same line). pad_to_net: 1 USB_DP, 6 USB_DP, 3 USB_DM, 4 USB_DM, 2 GND, 5 VBUS_USB. Match.
U5.footprint: KiCad Package_TO_SOT_SMD:SOT-23-6, pads 1.325 x 0.60 at 0.95 pitch, rows at +/-1.1375. p.5 outline: e 0.95 BSC, E 2.65-2.95, b 0.30-0.50, L 0.30-0.60; standard SOT-23-6, compatible. Pin 1 at (-, -0.95) top-left matches the p.1 drawing orientation.
U5.ratings: p.2: VRWM 5 V, VBR 6-9 V, IR 0.1 uA at 5 V, VC 10 V at 1 A / 15 V at 6 A (8/20 us), CJ 0.8 pF typ I/O-GND, 0.35 pF I/O-I/O; Ppk 150 W, IEC 61000-4-2 +/-30 kV air/contact. VBUS 5 V within VRWM; capacitance fine for 12 Mbps full speed.

LED1.part: XINGLIGHT XL-2020RGBC-WS2812B, 2.0 x 2.0 x 0.65 mm addressable RGB LED (LCSC C5349955)
LED1.pinout: p.11 pin table: 1 DO, 2 GND, 3 DI, 4 VDD. Top view (p.11): DI top-left, GND top-right, VDD bottom-left, DO bottom-right (pin 1 dot). Footprint pads (y down): 1 (+0.68,+0.65) bottom-right, 2 (+0.68,-0.65) top-right, 3 (-0.68,-0.65) top-left, 4 (-0.68,+0.65) bottom-left; matches. Symbol pins DO=1, GND=2, DI=3, VDD=4 match. pad_to_net: 1 NC (DO), 2 GND, 3 LED_DIN, 4 +3V3.
LED1.footprint: p.11 recommended soldering pattern: four 0.85 x 0.75 pads, 0.5 mm gap in X and Y (centers +/-0.675, +/-0.625). Footprint: 0.85 x 0.65 at +/-0.68, +/-0.65 (Y gap 0.65). Within 0.1 mm per pad, acceptable.
LED1.ratings: p.4 Absolute Maximum: VDD 3.5-5.5 V, VDI -0.5 to VDD+0.5 V. p.2 feature 7: VDD 4.5-5.5 V for 100% normal operation. p.5: VIH min 0.5 VDD, VIL max 0.25 VDD, IDD 0.5 mA, 5 mA per channel. LCSC listing also states 3.5-5.5 V.
LED1.config: VDD +3V3 with 100 nF, DI from ESP32-S3 IO39 through 100 ohm, DO unconnected. design.py comment: mirrors the QT Py NeoPixel powered from 3V3.
LED1.fixed: VDD moved from +3V3 to +5V (min 3.5 V, p.4); its 100 nF moved with it. DIN high threshold 0.5 x VDD = 2.8 V worst case, under the ESP32's 3.3 V CMOS high into this unloaded input.

C3.footprint: Capacitor_SMD:CP_Elec_6.3x7.7 vs p.2 dimensions for 6.3 x 8: base A1 = B1 = 6.6, C 2.7, terminal spacing P 1.8. Pads 3.5 x 1.6 with a 1.9 mm gap cover the terminals. Match; the can is 8 mm tall (the 3D model shows 7.7).
C3.ratings: 35 V (p.2 table) vs 17.4 V: 2.0 x. Ripple 300 mA rms at 105 C 100 kHz; impedance 0.34 ohm max at 100 kHz, the damping for hot-plug ringing. 2000 h at 105 C.
C3.config: Bottom side on the right ear, 18-21 mm free below the board (cad/keepout.json B_tall), pads along y.
